flags.name: --url
flags.description: Main URL to test

flags.name: --cookie
flags.description: Cookie value to be requested with each successive request. If there are multiple cookies, separate them with commas. For example: `-c PHPSESSID=i837c5n83u4, _gid=jdhfbuysf`.

flags.name: --output
flags.description: Output directory where files to be stored. Default is the output/ folder where all files generated will be stored.

flags.name: --delay
flags.description: Time delay between requests in seconds. Default is zero.

flags.name: --quiet
flags.description: Set the DEBUG mode to quiet. Report only when vulnerabilities are found. Minimal output will be printed on screen.

flags.name: --headers
flags.description: Comma separated list of custom headers you'd want to use. For example: ``--headers "Accept=text/php, X-Requested-With=XHR"``.

flags.name: --verbose
flags.description: Increase the verbosity of the output (e.g., -vv is more than -v).

flags.name: --timeout
flags.description: HTTP request timeout value in seconds. The entered value may be either in floating point decimal or an integer. Example: ``--timeout 10.0``

flags.name: --exclude
flags.description: Comma-separated paths / file containing paths (separated by newlines) to exclude when crawling and scanning.

flags.name: --user-agent
flags.description: Custom user-agent to be used. Only one user-agent can be specified.

flags.name: --max-chars
flags.description: Maximum allowed character length for the custom token value to be generated. For example: `--max-chars 5`. Default value is 6.

flags.name: --crawl
flags.description: Crawl the whole site and simultaneously test all discovered endpoints for CSRF.

flags.name: --max-urls
flags.description: Maximum number of URLs to crawl (with --crawl). 0 means unlimited. Default: 200.

flags.name: --max-depth
flags.description: Maximum link depth to crawl from the seed URL (with --crawl). 0 means unlimited. Default: 5.

flags.name: --crawl-timeout
flags.description: Wall-clock time budget for crawling in seconds (with --crawl). 0 means unlimited. Default: 0.

flags.name: --no-analysis
flags.description: Skip the Post-Scan Analysis of Tokens which were gathered during requests

flags.name: --skip-poc
flags.description: Skip the PoC Form Generation of POST-Based Cross Site Request Forgeries.

flags.name: --no-verify
flags.description: Do not verify SSL certificates with requests.

flags.name: --debug
flags.description: Print out requests and responses while making requests.

flags.name: --random-agent
flags.description: Use random user-agents for making requests.

flags.name: --version
flags.description: Display the version of XSRFProbe and exit.

flags.name: --json
flags.description: Output the results into a JSON file.

flags.name: --force-header-tests
flags.description: Run Referer/Origin header tests even when an anti-CSRF token is confirmed enforced. Research/opt-in only: bypass requests still carry a valid token, so results on token-protected endpoints are false positives.

flags.name: --browser
flags.description: Enable headless Firefox browser for SameSite and browser-dependent tests.

flags.name: --auto-validate-poc
flags.description: Auto-validate generated PoC files in headless browser (requires --browser).

flags.name: --geckodriver-path
flags.description: Path to geckodriver binary. Default: assumes geckodriver is in PATH.

flags.name: --browser-timeout
flags.description: Page load timeout for headless browser in seconds. Default: 30.

flags.name: --enum-subdomains
flags.description: Enable subdomain enumeration via crt.sh for SameSite=Strict sibling domain bypass tests.

flags.name: --no-form-submit
flags.description: Do not submit forms during scanning. Only perform passive token detection.
